title: A change of plans
description: A weekend plan changes. Find out where the friends go and what they take.

media.text: Hi, I’m Alex. On Saturday, my friend Jamie and I want to ride our bikes to the lake. But in the morning it starts to rain. We decide to visit the city museum instead. We meet at the bus stop at ten thirty. Jamie brings two sandwiches and I bring some water. After the museum, we call our friend Sam. Sam is at home and joins us for lunch.
